data.name: AlertsDescription
data.value: An inline message in four severities and three fills, with an optional title, icon and close cross.

data.name: AlertsSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting applies to the alert in the preview below.

data.name: AlertsSeverityDescription
data.value: The severity chooses the colour and the default sample text.

data.name: AlertsVariantDescription
data.value: Outline stays light on the page, tonal puts a light tint behind the text, filled is for a message that must not be scrolled past.

data.name: AlertsShowTitleDescription
data.value: A bold line above the message.

data.name: AlertsShowIconDescription
data.value: The icon slot, filled here with the icon of the severity.

data.name: AlertsLiveDescription
data.value: A live alert interrupts the screen reader; otherwise it waits for a pause.

data.name: AlertsLongTextDescription
data.value: Checks how the message wraps next to the icon.

data.name: AlertsDismissibleDescription
data.value: Dismissible adds the cross; without it, an alert stays displayed.

data.name: ProgressDescription
data.value: A linear or circular gauge, determinate or not, in six colours, with the logo loader and the status badges and strips. A simulation shows it filling up.

data.name: ProgressSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting applies to the gauge in the preview below.

data.name: ProgressToneDescription
data.value: The colour says what the progress means: normal, neutral, informative, done, at risk or failing.

data.name: ProgressValueDescription
data.value: From 0 to 100. Unavailable while the gauge is indeterminate.

data.name: ProgressIndeterminateDescription
data.value: For work whose end is unknown: the gauge moves without a value.

data.name: ProgressShowValueDescription
data.value: Writes the percentage, or the custom text, next to the gauge.

data.name: ProgressCustomValueTextDescription
data.value: Replaces the percentage, on screen and for screen readers.

data.name: ProgressLabelDescription
data.value: Read by screen readers. Left empty, the component uses its own default name.

data.name: ProgressSimulateDescription
data.value: Runs the value from 0 to 100 in eight seconds.

data.name: SkeletonsDescription
data.value: A placeholder shaped like the content it replaces while it loads, named for screen readers or purely decorative.

data.name: SkeletonsSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting applies to the skeleton in the preview below.

data.name: SkeletonsShapeDescription
data.value: Text lines, a picture block or an avatar.

data.name: SkeletonsLineCountDescription
data.value: From 1 to 10, for the text shape only.

data.name: SkeletonsNamedDescription
data.value: Named, the skeleton announces the loading; otherwise it is hidden from screen readers.

data.name: SkeletonsLoadedDescription
data.value: Swaps the skeleton for the content it stands for.

data.name: SkeletonsLinesTitle
data.value: Line counts of the text shape

data.name: ProgressLoadingDescription
data.value: The loading bar under a header follows a real load, sweeping or filling, reaches the end then fades. A busy button keeps its size and content (a veil breathes over it), and the skeleton takes the shape of what it replaces.
